name: Villalba de la Lampreana (Spain)
description: Blue field with a red cross throughout edged white, charged with a white lamprey in each quarter.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved by municipal resolution on 8 October 2002 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 31 October 2002; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a full red cross fimbriated white and cantoned blue with a white lamprey.

features.role: edges of the cross and lampreys in the quarters
